form.title: Foreign Tax Credit (Individual, Estate, or Trust)
form.notes: refundable: false. Line 35 goes to Schedule 3 Part I line 1, inside the tax computation. THE DE MINIMIS ELECTION: a taxpayer may claim the credit on Schedule 3 line 1 WITHOUT filing this form at all, if all four conditions hold — all foreign source gross income was passive category income; all the income and any foreign taxes paid on it were reported on a qualified payee statement (Form 1099-DIV, 1099-INT, Schedule K-1 or similar); total creditable foreign taxes are not more than $300 ($600 if married filing a joint return); and the taxpayer is not an estate or trust. Under the election the figure entered on Schedule 3 line 1 is the smaller of total foreign tax or regular tax. Schedule 3 line 1 says so on its own face: 'Attach Form 1116 IF REQUIRED.' That is why routes.foreign-tax.de-minimis-election->schedule3.1 exists as a separate route with its own condition. Only Part IV is transcribed in full below plus the Part III lines that produce the credit; Parts I and II are the per-category income and taxes worked out for each separate category of income and are transcribed to the extent they carry the limitation arithmetic. Printed revision: Form 1116 (2025), Created 9/16/25.
